$comment: Generated by generate.main.kts. Golden ring file plans (docs/pack-format.md#ring-files): a ringtone measuring sourceMs with these loop and fadeInMs values renders as the intro [0, loopStartMs) once, the loop section [loopStartMs, loopEndMs) loopCount times, then silenceMs of silence, with a fade-in over the first fadeInMs. passThrough means the source file can be used as is. A missing loop is the default (true).

cases.description: Whole-file loop (the default) of a 6 s ringtone: repeated to 90 s.
loop: true is the same as no loop key.
Loop section from the start, the 1 s after it is an outro that never plays; the fade-in happens once.
Intro of 1 s, then the open loop to the end, repeated until the file reaches 90 s.
Intro, loop and outro, as in the kitchen orchestra demo ringtone.
A loop end within the 50 ms tolerance past the end of the audio is clamped to the end.
Play once, padded with silence to 90 s so it does not restart right away.
Play once, longer than 90 s and without fade-in: the source file is the ring file.
Whole-file loop longer than 90 s: the source file is the ring file.
The same with a fade-in: rendered once, as the fade must not repeat.
A long loop that already passes 90 s plays once; the outro is cut.
An intro that almost reaches 90 s, then the 1.5 s loop once.
